name: Five-card draw
summary: Classic poker where players are dealt five cards, bet, replace cards to improve, bet again and showdown.
rules_text: Each player antes or posts blinds and is dealt five face-down cards from a 52-card deck. There is a first betting round starting left of dealer or big blind; players may fold, call or raise. Remaining players then discard any number of cards (0 to 5) and are dealt replacements from the deck to restore to five cards. A second betting round follows, starting left of dealer. If two or more players remain after betting, there is a showdown; best standard poker hand wins the pot. If all but one fold, the last player wins without showdown.
rating_reason: Specific poker variant, hidden hands, betting bluffing
